pages_read.title: Fwd: UnrealIRCd 6.2.7.1 released & hot-patch to fix 9 security issues, including one CRITICAL (CVE-2026-114713)

updated.what: UnrealIRCd advisory (dated 7 Nov, forwarded to oss-security 23 Nov) added as a source: summary and action now give the vendor's fix (6.2.7.1) and hot-patch for 6.0.0 - 6.2.7 for CVE-2026-114713; CISA alert source given its published day.

notes: The oss-security post does not mention exploitation or CISA; nothing about Check Point changed. No published fact contradicted, so no correction file. The vendor pages on unrealircd.org were not opened.
